exercises.prompt: In Qur'an 1:5 (إِيَّاكَ نَعْبُدُ وَإِيَّاكَ نَسْتَعِينُ), what is the verb form and root of نَسْتَعِينُ?
choices: Form X hollow verb (اِسْتَفْعَلَ) from root ع-و-ن
Form I sound verb from root س-ت-ع
Form IV verb from root ع-ي-ن
exercises.answer: Form X hollow verb (اِسْتَفْعَلَ) from root ع-و-ن
exercises.explanation: Strip imperfect نَـ and Form X ـسْتَـ to recover the hollow root ع-و-ن ('help' → Form X 'seek help').

feedback.rule: Form X (اِسْتَفْعَلَ) expresses seeking/requesting; hollow و shifts to ī in يَسْتَعِينُ.
